pool.text: Frederick I Barbarossa brought the destruction of much of Milan.
Milan returned to the commune form of local government after the Peace of Constance.
The Antica trattoria Bagutto has existed in Italy since this year.
Gian Galeazzo Visconti became the first Duke of Milan.
The Republic collapsed when Milan was conquered by Francesco I.
French rule in the Duchy of Milan ended at the Battle of Pavia.
Turandot by Giacomo Puccini premiered at La Scala opera house.
The huge Central railway station was inaugurated as an example of Art Deco.
Blessed cardinal A.I. Schuster founded the Pontifical Ambrosian Institute of Sacred Music.
The Holy See raised the Pontifical Ambrosian Institute of Sacred Music.
The Italian resistance seized control of the city and executed Mussolini.
Milan's fashion exports accounted for US$726 million.
The airport started serving mostly as a general aviation airfield for flying clubs.
The Milan Metro design received the Compasso d'Oro award.
A bomb exploded at the National Agrarian Bank in Piazza Fontana.
The implementation of a city-wide network of bike paths began to fight congestion.
Trenord began operating both Trenitalia and LeNord regional trains in Lombardy.
The partnership with Saint Petersburg was suspended due to the Russian government's prohibition.
Museo delle Culture opened in April.
Fiera Milano hosted international exhibitions with more than 4 million visitors.
